name: Ri'kan's Vibro-Axe
description: By the time of the Third Galactic War, Ri'kan's Vibro-Axe was a vibro-axe utilized by Ri'kan Kateen, a Force-sensitive Twi'lek who served as a Mandalorian of the Hidden Chain. The vibro-axe conducted an open electric current that could be either yellow or blue in coloration.
